collection.description: A Heathen teen has grown so much that the mask grandmother made now sits halfway up their forehead.

description_variants.description: An Isolan teen has grown so much that the mask grandmother made now sits halfway up their forehead.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) has grown so much this year that (his/her) mask now sits halfway up (his/her) forehead. Everyone at the camp has noticed. Nobody has said anything, because the mask was made by (his/her) grandmother.

choices.label: Ask Grandmother for a New One

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) asks. Grandmother laughs until she has to sit down, and then spends three days carving a new mask, a bit too big "so you can grow into it." (name1) wears it with enormous pride.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) carves (his/her) own. It is lopsided and has one eye bigger than the other. Grandmother says it is the best mask she has ever seen, and keeps the old one on her wall.
